title: The farm: rows and fields
reflection: Byte sowed and harvested a whole field with a few lines, a loop inside a loop. Where do farmers really use machines that follow a program? What would you add to Byte's to make it a better farmer?

steps.goal: MINE has dug a field in front of Byte: 3 rows of 5 farmland blocks, with water on the left. Byte flies one block above the field (byte.up() first) and sows it all with the wheat seeds in its highlighted slot (byte.placeDown()).
steps.not_yet: Not yet: every farmland block of the field needs seeds.
hints: A row: 5 times byte.forward() and byte.placeDown(). Then back to the start of the row (5 times byte.back()) and over to the next one: byte.turnRight(), byte.forward(), byte.turnLeft().
A loop inside a loop: for row = 1, 3 do ... the whole row ... end.
block_hints: A row: "repeat 5 times" "move forward", "place a block below". Then "repeat 5 times" "move back", and "turn right", "move forward", "turn left" to the next row.
A "repeat 3 times" around all of it: a loop inside a loop. Don't forget "move up" at the start.

steps.goal: Now the wheat has grown, but not all of it: some is ripe (golden), some still young (green), in new places every time. Harvest only the ripe wheat (byte.digDown()) and sow again where you harvested.
steps.not_yet: Not yet: harvest and sow again all the ripe wheat, and leave the young wheat where it is.
hints: byte.ripeDown() is true when the wheat under Byte is ripe.
In the row: byte.forward(), then if byte.ripeDown() then byte.digDown() byte.placeDown() end.
block_hints: "ripe crop below?" is true when the wheat under Byte is ripe.
In the row: "move forward", then "if" "ripe crop below?": "dig below", "place a block below".

steps.goal: A new field to harvest: this time Byte also says how much ripe wheat it harvested. Count it with a variable: MINE counts it too.
steps.not_yet: Not yet: harvest the ripe wheat, sow again, and make Byte say how many it harvested.
hints: Before the loops, local harvested = 0; inside the if, harvested = harvested + 1.
At the end, mine.say("I harvested " .. harvested .. " wheat").
block_hints: Make a variable "harvested": "set harvested to 0" at the start, "change harvested by 1" inside the "if".
At the end, "say" with "create text with": "I harvested ", harvested, " wheat".
